name: swisslifeops
description: The open-source Swiss life-admin layer. Flagship feature: open Swiss Post IncaMail secured government mail even when you have no IncaMail account (RAV, SAH, courts and insurers send it constantly). Plus RAV job-effort logging, tailored applications, tax-prep organising and a daily digest. Human-in-the-loop by design. Run /swisslifeops:setup once.

plugins.name: swisslifeops
plugins.description: Open IncaMail secured mail + run Swiss life-admin, human-in-the-loop — needs Playwright MCP and a Gmail MCP.
